proposal: The Mandate recommends that DOL approve non-public worker organizations as unemployment insurance administrators under section 303(a)(2) of the Social Security Act, offer waivers from the section 303(a) and 303(d) requirements to states proposing suitable alternatives, and require such organizations, as a condition of public funds, to follow political spending limits that apply to 501(c)(3) charities (p. 605); it also asks Congress for legislation allowing time-limited state and local waivers from federal labor laws such as the NLRA and FLSA (p. 605).
